top_blockers.blocker: Schema v1 used flat top-level score fields; CLI validator (feedback_submit) expects nested scores object and structured top_blockers — mismatch caused every agent feedback submission to fail validation.

recommended_next_builds: Add feedback-submit gate to CI/deploy workflow so schema drift is caught pre-merge.
Expose agentpress/feedback/response-template.json URL in llms.txt Feedback-Template field.
Add schema_version migration note to RELEASE_NOTES.md for v1→v2 feedback format.

patch_suggestions.change: Promoted to v2: nested scores object, structured top_blockers (severity/evidence_url_or_path/blocker), added schema_version/agent_id/target_url/submitted_utc/privacy as required fields.
Updated template to v2 format matching CLI validator requirements.
